provenance.encodes: UN document symbols (A/RES/<session>/<n>, S/RES/<n> (<year>), S/PV.<n>, A/HRC/RES/<n>/<n>) cited without the U.N. Doc. prefix
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the UN document symbol guide (research.un.org/en/docs/symbols) and Bluebook R21.7.

positive.text: The General Assembly adopted A/RES/61/295 in 2007.
Security Council resolution S/RES/1373 (2001) was binding.

note: Outranked by intl.un.document when `U.N. Doc.` precedes the symbol. url_templates: none; undocs.org answers 200 with the same language page for a real and a made-up symbol (A/RES/61/295, A/RES/99/9999; 2026-10-23), so a fetch cannot verify it.
